"a) Quash the Complaint dated 03.09.2021 and FIR dated 03.09.2021 registered in Crime No.94/2021 before VI ACMM Bengaluru City for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506, 323 R/w. Section 34 of IPC and Section 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act

b) Quash the charge sheet dated 26.11.2022 in CC No.33610/2021 before VI ACMM Bengaluru City,
for the offence punishable under Section 498A, 504, 506, 323 R/w Section 34 of IPC and Section 3,
4 of Dowry Prohibition Act in so far as petitioners are concerned (Annexure-C).
c) Quash the impugned Order of cognizance dated 26.11.2021 culminating in CC No.33610/2021 before VI ACMM, Bengaluru City, for the offence punishable 498A, 504, 506, 323 R/w. Section 34 of IPC and Section 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act in so far as petitioners are concerned (Annexure-D).
